faqs.q: How many passengers can a Hummer limo fit?
faqs.a: + Our stretch Hummer limousine comfortably seats up to 16 passengers, making it ideal for large groups, parties, and special events.

faqs.q: What features does the Hummer limo have?
faqs.a: + The Hummer limo comes fully loaded with a flat screen TV, premium sound system, leather seating, tinted privacy windows, iPod hookup, beverage bar, climate control, and luxury interior lighting.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to rent a Hummer limo?
faqs.a: + Pricing depends on the duration, distance, and day of the week. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote tailored to your specific event and itinerary.

faqs.q: Is the Hummer limo good for prom?
faqs.a: + Absolutely! The Hummer limo is one of the most popular choices for prom. The spacious interior fits large groups comfortably, and the party atmosphere makes it the perfect pre-dance cruiser.

faqs.q: Can I bring food and drinks in the Hummer?
faqs.a: + Yes, the Hummer limo features a beverage bar and ample space for snacks and refreshments. Our professional chauffeur ensures a clean and enjoyable experience throughout your ride.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book the Hummer limo?
faqs.a: + We recommend booking at least 2-4 weeks in advance, especially during prom season and peak event periods. However, we accommodate last-minute bookings whenever possible.

faqs.q: Do you serve the Anaheim area with the Hummer limo?
faqs.a: + Yes, we provide Hummer limo service throughout Anaheim and all of Orange County, including Los Angeles and surrounding areas. We cover all major venues, hotels, and attractions.
